ontology_competency_domains.name: Patient Care
ontology_competency_domains.description: Ability to provide patient care that is compassionate, appropriate, and effective for the treatment of health problems and the promotion of health.

ontology_competency_domains.name: Medical Knowledge
ontology_competency_domains.description: Demonstration of knowledge of established and evolving biomedical, clinical, and cognate sciences and the application of this knowledge to patient care.

ontology_competency_domains.name: Practice-Based Learning and Improvement
ontology_competency_domains.description: Ability to investigate and evaluate their patient care practices, appraise and assimilate scientific evidence, and improve their patient care practices.

ontology_competency_domains.name: Interpersonal and Communication Skills
ontology_competency_domains.description: Ability to demonstrate interpersonal and communication skills that result in effective information exchange and collaboration.

ontology_competency_domains.name: Professionalism
ontology_competency_domains.description: Demonstration of a commitment to carrying out professional responsibilities and an adherence to ethical principles.

ontology_competency_domains.name: Systems-Based Practice
ontology_competency_domains.description: Ability to work effectively in various health care settings and to manage system resources to provide care that is safe, timely, efficient, effective, and equitable.

ontology_competency_domains.name: Teaching and Facilitation
ontology_competency_domains.description: Ability to teach, facilitate learning, and assess learners

ontology_competency_domains.name: Mentorship and Sponsorship
ontology_competency_domains.description: Ability to mentor, coach, and sponsor learners and colleagues through career development

ontology_competency_domains.name: Leadership
ontology_competency_domains.description: Ability to lead, influence, and manage teams and initiatives

ontology_competency_domains.name: Administration
ontology_competency_domains.description: Ability to manage administrative responsibilities and programs

ontology_competency_domains.name: Well-Being
ontology_competency_domains.description: Commitment to personal well-being and support of others's well-being

ontology_competency_domains.name: Scholarship and Dissemination
ontology_competency_domains.description: Ability to conduct, evaluate, and disseminate scholarship

ontology_competency_domains.name: Innovation and Informatics
ontology_competency_domains.description: Ability to innovate and use technology to improve care and education

ontology_competency_domains.name: Advocacy
ontology_competency_domains.description: Ability to advocate for learners, patients, and systems

ontology_competency_domains.name: Professional Identity Formation
ontology_competency_domains.description: Ability to support development of professional identity in self and others

ontology_invisible_work_activities.plain_language_description: Provided reinforcing or corrective feedback to a learner or colleague to improve performance
Helped a learner or junior colleague think through career, performance, identity, or next steps
Recognized distress, burnout, or overwhelm in a colleague and responded supportively
Made an educational handout, guide, lecture, checklist, or teaching tool
Organized people around a decision, project, or improvement; facilitated discussion
Identified a broken process and changed or improved it
Aligned multiple people, services, or stakeholders around patient or program needs
Taught a clinical concept during rounds, supervision, or patient care
Noticed a colleague or learner struggling with burnout and took supportive action
Shared academic, educational, or quality improvement work through poster, talk, or abstract
Used feedback from others to change behavior or improve performance
Addressed interpersonal or workflow conflict; helped resolve tension between people or teams

ontology_invisible_work_activities.activity_name: Built tool, dashboard, or structured data system
ontology_invisible_work_activities.plain_language_description: Created a dashboard, spreadsheet, or data system to track or improve something

ontology_invisible_work_activities.activity_name: Advocated for learner, patient, or system change
ontology_invisible_work_activities.plain_language_description: Spoke up to address unfairness, bias, or barriers; advocated for change

ontology_output_templates.template_text: Mentored trainees in career development, professional identity formation, and clinical growth through individualized coaching and longitudinal support.
Demonstrated commitment to learner development and professional identity formation through longitudinal mentoring and personalized guidance.
Provided effective formative and summative feedback to learners to support ongoing professional development and performance improvement.
Designed and implemented educational resources and curriculum materials to support learner development and clinical education.
Curriculum development: Created {artifact_type} to teach {topic}, reaching {audience_size} learners and receiving positive feedback on {metric}.
Identified process improvement opportunities and led implementation of changes that enhanced efficiency, safety, or educational value.
Led workgroups, committees, and meetings to advance educational initiatives, quality improvement, and program development.
Disseminated scholarly work through {format}: {title}, presented at {venue} to advance {field} knowledge.

signal_indicators.indicator_name: Coaching junior on career/identity
signal_indicators.description: User is guiding someone through career thinking, identity formation, or professional development
signal_indicators.followup_question: Was this a one-time conversation or part of an ongoing mentoring relationship?

signal_indicators.indicator_name: Helping junior navigate a challenge
signal_indicators.description: User is providing support and guidance to a less experienced colleague
signal_indicators.followup_question: What specifically did you help them understand or navigate?

signal_indicators.indicator_name: Advocating for someone's advancement
signal_indicators.description: User is actively supporting someone's career advancement or opportunity
signal_indicators.followup_question: What made you want to advocate for this person?

signal_indicators.indicator_name: Supporting professional identity formation
signal_indicators.description: User is helping someone develop or clarify professional identity
signal_indicators.followup_question: How is their professional identity formation going?

signal_indicators.indicator_name: Led meeting or workgroup
signal_indicators.description: User organized and directed a meeting or group discussion
signal_indicators.followup_question: What was the outcome or decision from that meeting?

signal_indicators.indicator_name: Addressed interpersonal or team conflict
signal_indicators.description: User navigated interpersonal conflict or helped others resolve it
signal_indicators.followup_question: How did you approach the conflict? What did you learn?

signal_indicators.indicator_name: Influenced an important decision
signal_indicators.description: User shaped a significant decision or outcome through influence
signal_indicators.followup_question: What was the decision and how did your influence matter?

signal_indicators.indicator_name: Managing or overseeing a team
signal_indicators.description: User is in a formal or informal leadership role managing others
signal_indicators.followup_question: What's the size of your team and what's been most challenging?

signal_indicators.indicator_name: Identified a broken process
signal_indicators.description: User recognized a process or system inefficiency
signal_indicators.followup_question: Did you propose a fix or change? What would improve it?

signal_indicators.indicator_name: Proposed or implemented a process change
signal_indicators.description: User suggested or enacted a process improvement
signal_indicators.followup_question: What was the impact of that change? How did people respond?

signal_indicators.indicator_name: Aligning or coordinating across silos
signal_indicators.description: User worked to connect or integrate separate parts of a system
signal_indicators.followup_question: What barriers did you have to overcome to coordinate that?

signal_indicators.indicator_name: Reduced handoff friction or communication gaps
signal_indicators.description: User improved transitions or communication between steps in a process
signal_indicators.followup_question: How did the handoff improvement happen? What made it work?

signal_indicators.indicator_name: Spoke up about an unfair or wrong situation
signal_indicators.description: User took a stand or voiced a concern about something wrong
signal_indicators.followup_question: What made you feel like you had to speak up?

signal_indicators.indicator_name: Addressed bias, inequity, or discrimination
signal_indicators.description: User actively worked against bias or unfair treatment
signal_indicators.followup_question: What was the situation and what did you do?

signal_indicators.indicator_name: Advocated for resources, support, or policy change
signal_indicators.description: User pushed for institutional resources or changes in support of people or mission
signal_indicators.followup_question: What did you ask for and did you get it?

signal_indicators.indicator_name: Advocated for or protected a person
signal_indicators.description: User actively advocated for or protected an individual
signal_indicators.followup_question: What were the stakes? Why was it important to advocate for them?

signal_indicators.indicator_name: Supported colleague through distress or struggle
signal_indicators.description: User provided emotional support to someone in distress
signal_indicators.followup_question: What did supporting them look like? How are they doing now?

signal_indicators.indicator_name: Recognized burnout or well-being concern in self or others
signal_indicators.description: User recognized signs of burnout or well-being crisis
signal_indicators.followup_question: What made you notice the burnout? What helped or could help?

signal_indicators.indicator_name: Helped someone process difficult emotions or experience
signal_indicators.description: User provided space and support for emotional processing
signal_indicators.followup_question: What was the emotion or experience they were processing?

signal_indicators.indicator_name: Connected someone to support or resources
signal_indicators.description: User helped someone access formal or informal support
signal_indicators.followup_question: Were they able to access the resource? Did it help?

signal_indicators.indicator_name: Maintained professional boundaries while supporting
signal_indicators.description: User showed awareness of appropriate boundaries in support
signal_indicators.followup_question: How do you navigate the balance between support and boundaries?

signal_indicators.indicator_name: Taught during rounds, supervision, or clinical care
signal_indicators.description: User engaged in opportunistic clinical teaching
signal_indicators.followup_question: What clinical topic did you teach? How did the learner respond?

signal_indicators.indicator_name: Created curriculum, slides, handout, or teaching tool
signal_indicators.description: User developed educational content or materials
signal_indicators.followup_question: Who used this resource and was it effective?

signal_indicators.indicator_name: Facilitated a learning discussion or case conference
signal_indicators.description: User designed and led a structured learning experience
signal_indicators.followup_question: How did learners engage with that learning activity?

signal_indicators.indicator_name: Gave formative or corrective feedback
signal_indicators.description: User delivered performance or learning feedback
signal_indicators.followup_question: How did they receive the feedback? Did they change?

signal_indicators.indicator_name: Received and acted on feedback
signal_indicators.description: User demonstrated openness to and integration of feedback
signal_indicators.followup_question: What feedback did you get and how did it change your practice?

signal_indicators.indicator_name: Reflected on experience or practice
signal_indicators.description: User engaged in reflective practice or learning from experience
signal_indicators.followup_question: What was the biggest lesson from that reflection?

signal_indicators.indicator_name: Presented work at conference or forum
signal_indicators.description: User disseminated work through presentation
signal_indicators.followup_question: What was the response? What next for this work?

signal_indicators.indicator_name: Published or submitted for publication
signal_indicators.description: User published or is publishing scholarly work
signal_indicators.followup_question: What is the paper/publication about? What's the impact?

signal_indicators.indicator_name: Conducted or leading research or QI project
signal_indicators.description: User is engaged in research or systematic improvement work
signal_indicators.followup_question: What's the research question or improvement goal?

signal_indicators.indicator_name: Built dashboard, spreadsheet, or data system
signal_indicators.description: User created technology or data infrastructure
signal_indicators.followup_question: What problem did that tool solve? Who uses it?

signal_indicators.indicator_name: Improved EHR workflow or clinical informatics
signal_indicators.description: User worked with technology to improve clinical or administrative work
signal_indicators.followup_question: How did EHR improvement help? What's the impact?

signal_indicators.indicator_name: Expressing declining energy or motivation
keywords: not sure why I'm doing this
signal_indicators.description: User is expressing signs of energy depletion or burnout
signal_indicators.followup_question: What's been draining your energy most lately?

signal_indicators.indicator_name: Finding meaning, fulfillment, or purpose in work
signal_indicators.description: User is experiencing meaning or satisfaction in their work
signal_indicators.followup_question: What aspect of your work feels most meaningful right now?

signal_indicators.indicator_name: Struggling with work-life balance or boundaries
signal_indicators.description: User is aware of work-life balance challenges
signal_indicators.followup_question: What would help you achieve better balance?

signal_indicators.indicator_name: Exploring professional identity or role transition
keywords: who do I want to be
signal_indicators.description: User is actively exploring or transitioning professional identity
signal_indicators.followup_question: Tell me more about the professional identity you're developing or exploring.

signal_indicators.indicator_name: Uncertainty about career direction or next steps
signal_indicators.description: User is uncertain about career trajectory or options
signal_indicators.followup_question: What are the options you're considering?

signal_indicators.indicator_name: Lacking confidence or development in teaching/admin
signal_indicators.description: User identifies a gap in teaching or administration skills
signal_indicators.followup_question: What aspect of teaching or administration would you most like to develop?

signal_indicators.indicator_name: Lacking confidence or development in research/scholarship
signal_indicators.description: User identifies a gap in research or scholarship skills
signal_indicators.followup_question: What would scholarly work or research look like for you?

signal_conversational_routes.route_template: That mentoring work is meaningful. Was this a one-time conversation or part of a longer relationship you're building with them?
Leading that took vision and presence. What was the outcome? Did the group move forward?
You identified something broken and fixed it—that's systems thinking in action. Do you see yourself in a systems-leader role?
Speaking up for what's right takes courage. I want to honor that you did.
Holding space for someone in distress is real work and it matters. How are *you* doing with this?
